title: Chong Wei: Discipline headache not over at BAM training centre

title: Roosters coach clips Walker’s management after $5m leak
desc:
Roosters coach Trent Robinson has taken a swipe at Sam Walker’s management after reports leaked the star halfback had knocked back a contract extension.
Brisbane’s The Courier Mail on Wednesday reported Walker baulked at signing a four-year deal worth $5 million.
